title: Retrieval from scratch
hints: cosine: the dot product divided by the product of the two lengths. Return 0.0 when a length is 0.
chunk: a while loop over start positions, moving by size - overlap. Append words[start:start + size], and stop when start + size reaches the end.
top_k: sorted(documents, key=lambda doc: cosine(query, doc["vector"]), reverse=True)[:k]. Python's sort keeps ties in their original order.
build_prompt: a list of parts (the first line, one passage block each, the question line), joined with "\n\n".
